key_findings: Intranasal anti-HuR ASO restored myelin and attenuated pain hypersensitivity in MOG- and PLP-EAE mice, and reduced BBB leakage in MOG-EAE.
Anti-HuR ASO increased HuD in GAP43-expressing cells, while in PLP-EAE it reduced microglial activation and cytokines.
